statistic: Mean of two per-process medians per ABBA state; microseconds per complete query. Raw samples and paired medians remain available; this is not a confidence interval.

correctness.policy: Every SQL record uses the selected API. Query collection is external for every record. No failure allowlist, mixed API routing or un-authored skips are accepted.

diagnostics.caveat: Engine cache bounds do not bound VM-retained classes or machine code; every churn observation is preserved.
